source_policy: Official DeepSeek Harness GitHub/docs only for external mechanism claims; local Praxis cards are cited separately as the consumed baseline. No external repository was installed or run.

sources.summary: Official architecture defines Cordis plugin/bundle/profile composition, HMR boundary, durable vs live event domains, session log, and extension map.
sources.boundary: Documentation describes current master/rc2 source shape; it does not establish security isolation or stable API guarantees.

sources.summary: LlmRuntime owns adapter route registration, configurable provider directory, atomic replacement, model discovery, and adapter-generation-bound calls.
sources.boundary: Registry atomicity is an in-process composition contract; it does not prove remote gateway health, failover, or credential policy.

sources.summary: ScheduleService stores Host-wide task rows and delivery history while keeping original Session binding; management reads do not activate Sessions.
claims: No Session activation for management reads
sources.boundary: Task delivery remains session-bound conversational follow-up; no external notification or exactly-once receipt is promised.

sources.summary: ScheduleRuntime drives due tasks through one timer/serialized operation, followup, flush, and commit; failures keep tasks active.
sources.boundary: No external run service or process-independent execution is shown by this source.

sources.summary: Plugin Manager performs profile-wide plugin/bundle operations, HMR recomposition, installation recovery and compatibility checks with approval boundaries.
sources.boundary: Installed Host code runs in-process; profile-wide changes affect all Sessions; package replacement may still require restart.

sources.summary: UserQuestionService validates structured questions and routes them through a scoped answerer waterfall; delegated child callers are rejected.
sources.boundary: Question intent changes presentation only and is not an authority/permission decision.

sources.summary: Subagent provider capabilities are checked before start; provider/model/depth/tool-filter/persona/schema options are explicit and fail loud when unsupported.
sources.boundary: toolFilter is not authority, sandbox, or parent policy; provider capability declarations are not an enterprise authorization model.

sources.summary: Continuable child lifecycle uses durable Session descriptors, process-local Activations, inbox-only queueing, exact adjacent authorization, and cold resume.
sources.boundary: Activation is process-local; durable child Session survival does not imply a running executor survives process loss.

sources.summary: SessionPersistence is a handle-based single-writer durability seam with append/flush checkpoints and explicit interrupted-turn recovery.
sources.boundary: This is DSH Session recovery; it does not establish Courtwork effect receipt or external side-effect idempotency.

sources.summary: Permission presets bundle sandbox and approval knobs; Auto is an effect-scoped current-session option and preset selection is durable log-only intent.
sources.boundary: Preset composition owns no execution policy; actual enforcement remains in sandbox/approval/tool seams.

sources.summary: Auto review is an opt-in experimental per-call reviewer with deny-to-human-ask behavior under ask policy and final denial under never.
claims: Manual continuation after deny under ask
sources.boundary: Official README explicitly says no deterministic sandbox, persistent grants, or configurable policy; it is not a security proof.

sources.summary: Auto review source binds the reviewer to the current provider/model, prepends tools/pre-execute, separates denial/failure, and drains on unload.
sources.boundary: Source path shows in-process policy mechanics only; it does not cover live product behavior across platforms.

sources.summary: Generic jobs contract provides owner-scoped ids, output/read/wait/kill, first-wins settlement and completion observation; shipped registry is process-local.
sources.boundary: Restart durability and cross-process identity require a different backend; this package alone cannot support rc.2 Desktop persistence claims.

sources.summary: Model-facing job tools deliver busy-owner next-step notices or idle-owner wakeups, with configurable wait/wakeup caps.
sources.boundary: Pending notices do not survive owner disposal; wakeup is not a durable scheduler.
